featured_reviews.name: KATHI ANILKUMAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
Know Your Own Bike – Bicycle Shop

Know Your Own Bike is an excellent all-rounder bicycle maintenance store where riders can get complete support for their bikes — from maintenance and servicing to upgrades. The store also assists customers in buying new bikes or selling their existing ones.

The owner, Mr. Gazi Ali, is himself a passionate cyclist who truly understands the value of a bicycle and the importance of proper maintenance. With his experience as a rider, he is able to quickly identify issues and guide customers in understanding the problems with their bikes. What stands out is his honest approach — he always tries to resolve issues within a minimal and reasonable budget.

My association with him and his store started in March 2025, and it has been growing stronger ever since. As a regular rider covering around 50 km daily, maintaining my bike in good condition is extremely important. Mr. Gazi has been very supportive in keeping my bike well maintained.

With his guidance, I was able to purchase a pre-owned premium MTB within my budget, and I also bought an indoor bike trainer from his store, which has been working really well.

He also maintains a good collection of premium bicycles in the store, which are available on rental basis as per customer requirements. Another thoughtful service he provides is offering a spare bicycle (based on availability) when a customer's bike is given for servicing, which is extremely helpful for regular riders.

Mr. Gazi is a very humble person who never overcharges customers. He welcomes everyone with a smile and ensures that customers leave the store satisfied, with their bikes in excellent condition after servicing.

Another great aspect of his service is flexibility — he schedules servicing based on customer convenience and also provides home pickup and drop services for bikes, depending on availability. He also helps in shipping bicycles between cities through his network of trusted vendors.

Additionally, he has expertise in converting regular bicycles into e-bikes at a budget-friendly cost, which is a unique and valuable service for riders.
Overall, I would rate his service and hospitality 100/100.

Wishing him continued success and all the very best for the future!

featured_reviews.name: Yashwin S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible.

This is the state this person abandoned my work in. He’s nothing but a lethargic time waster. He doesn’t stock any parts. He barely has any proper tools even. He didn’t even have a gear puller. I had to put together a makeshift one for him to use or the work was at a complete halt. When asked to order some spares, he told me to order them instead. He couldn’t even fix 4 spokes on my bike. He has no understanding of time both his own & that of others. He told me his lunch time is 1-4 pm. No joke. Most of the time he’s either sick or out of town or facing some problem. If you give him your bike he’ll expect you to wait indefinitely without offering any time frame or deadline. If you tell him to hurry he’ll start shouting back at you. He’ll keep saying tomorrow, tomorrow for a whole week and then show up when you’re not available and tell you that he came and you weren’t there. If you ask him to sort some issue with the bike out, he’ll reply with “Ok” and nothing else for days. And when you ask him what the hell happened he’ll tell you that the part isn’t available and will need to be ordered. Which he should have told you and ordered already days prior. And then when you get worked up with him for wasting your time he’ll say he can’t do your work and dump your bike in whatever state it’s in, dismantled, unrepaired, stored poorly, rusted in front of your building and disappear. He is irresponsible, incompetent, inept & indifferent. He has no sense of duty or decency. He’ll burden you with his struggles but never understand or care about your requirements or urgency. He thinks he can treat good, honest & generous people however he pleases and get away with it. Just an awful person really. If you notice all the positive reviews are all from first time customers. Which I was too. He appeared very diligent, sincere, amicable and respectful at first. But later on he becomes a nightmare to work with. He made it so that I used to literally think a hundred times before contacting him for anything. Knowing that he’d refuse me or worse yet, agree to doing the work but taking his own sweet time during which I couldn’t ask him anything. And no I wasn’t tight fisted or anything. I gave him whatever amount he’d ask for and even more actually in the hope that he would hurry things along. I have GPay transaction records conforming my account and my entire WhatsApp conversation history as well.

And here’s the thing. I wasn’t expecting any superhuman effort. I ultimately fixed my bike on my own after watching a few videos and ordering parts online. It took me a little more than an hour in total once the parts arrived. Genuine high quality parts which btw, I managed to source locally & took 2 days in total to get to me. If I could source the parts with little to no knowledge within 2 days and if I could fix the bike without any prior training or practice within a couple of hours, why should I be ok with a supposed professional I was paying to take weeks and months? He’s got one thing right, the name of his so called bike repair shop: KYOB. Because you’re better off KYOB & FYOB … Knowing and Fixing Your Own Bikes than taking them to him.

Thank you for your feedback.

Dear Yash,

I know that you and I are both aware that the problems that you have stated is not with respect to your personal purchase & experience. featured_reviews.name: jojo borayantu
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is the absolute best and incredible If you ride BMX or skateboard this is your go-to spot. Their inventory is next level—they always have the latest decks, complete bikes, high-quality hardware, and gear for both sports.What really sets them apart is the staff. They’re super knowledgeable genuinely helpful and never pushy. They'll help you dial in your setup from picking the right trucks to troubleshooting a custom BMX build. Its more than a store its the heart of the local scene . Highly recommended for all riders from beginners to pros. Hope to see more stores from sharptune in future . One in himachal pradesh for sure .

featured_reviews.name: Eddie P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Brilliant place to get your MTB, Road Bike or a BMX for some TLC and you will not want to  service your bike anywhere else except here, that’s the quality of work I saw at Sharptune
My rims were cracked got it replaced and the spokes needed to be changed to new ones too.
Other than that all the parts were opened and cleaned, greased etc. for a smooth running. Kudos to the guys at Sharptune

featured_reviews.name: Monish Dayal
featured_reviews.review_text: This is not your average bike repair shop. The guys at Sharp Tune took my bike, stripped down to the bare frame and brought it back to me as good as new. Deepak is super knowledgeable and very helpful. Couldn't be happier with the result. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: My favourite Go-To local bike shop (LBS). Dipak is really chill, and he and his crew are extremely talented and knowledgeable.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly recommend SharpTune to anyone who owns a high-end bicycle. Dipak Panchal is the best in the business!

Dipak is knowledgeable about all aspects of bicycle maintenance and repair. He uses high-quality parts.
If you are looking for a bicycle service technician who knows what they are doing, then Dipak is the person to see.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Had some pretty serious issues and risky ones as well with my rear suspension and Deepak Bhaiya kept his cool and explained everything to me also tried his best to get it resolved. While the problem isn’t fully resolved due to lacks of parts available for my bike in India I’m pretty happy to see someone who is excited and drived towards cycling and to help others. I would recommend this place to everyone and anyone who needs his cycle to work in pristine condition 🙌🏼. It also doesn’t drill holes in your pocket so that’s a win win.
